query:
SELECT id
           FROM attendance_records
           WHERE company_id = $1
             AND employee_id <> $2
             AND (
                 (check_in_cookie_id = $3 AND check_in_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours')
                 OR (check_out_cookie_id = $3 AND check_out_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours')
             )
